svg.title: Flowchart: How does the whole system fit together?
svg.desc: Flowchart of Aegis Sentinel: six intake channels, the scan engine, the isolated worker with its detection stages, scoring, and eight result destinations.

g.text: 1 Intake channels: every way a file reaches the scanner
4 Worker process: _worker_main() runs scan_file(path), the detection pipeline
the file or its result moves on
intake channel codes, repeated on each destination that channel reaches
a file, a folder or all folders
new or changed files, once settled
all scan folders (a folder the GUI names:
service come in through run_scan(), which
walks each folder; keeps the configured file
types; skips canary files, ~$ lock files and
a batch of files; collects every result
A pool of spawned worker processes: up to 4 by default, 1 with a VirusTotal key. One file per worker at a time, with a
time limit (SCAN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, 300 s) and a memory limit (WORKER_MEMORY_MB, 2048). The path goes
out over a pipe; every reply comes back as JSON and is checked before it is used.
ScoringMatrix.score(Signals) adds the weighted contributions, capped per category, into
a risk score 0-100 and the verdict Clean, Low, Medium, High or Critical. assess() sets
scan_status: complete, unsupported, partial, locked or failed.
Time limit: the latest snapshot is kept, or stopped_result()
marks the stalled layers (partial). No snapshot, a crash, an
'error' or invalid reply, or the memory limit: failure_result()
(scan_failed, status failed). A stopped worker is replaced.
encrypts the file (AES-256-GCM), verifies its SHA-256,
one row per file as it finishes, details on demand;
folder-monitor results too when monitoring runs in the GUI
the text report, printed by --scan-file, --scan-now and
the result as api/scan_result.schema.json; HTTP 503 when
<id>.quar files; restored with --restore or from the GUI
ransomware_scan_<time>.json and .txt in the report folder
one result per line at JSONL_PATH, for a SIEM or log
signed webhook and e-mail from the alert level up (default
High), retried for up to 24 h; the API sends e-mail only
redacted reports and logs to an S3-compatible bucket
each member goes through the same pipeline at depth + 1 (limit: max_nesting = 2)
reply over the pipe: 'ok' and the result (JSON, checked before use)
Flowchart: How does the whole system fit together?
Follow a file from any intake channel to its outputs. Branch review/production-hardening, commit e012d3f.
